name: nostr-signer-chatgpt
description: Connect a user-controlled NIP-46 signer without exposing an nsec.

interface.longDescription: Pair a bunker-compatible NIP-46 signer, review exact events, approve signatures in the signer, and publish only with separate confirmation. Private keys never enter the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Nostr note for my review.
